expectations.text: bike-rental.design.json exists next to the spec, is valid JSON and has the top-level keys spec, focus, equivalence_classes, boundary_values, state_transitions, tests, unknowns
Every quote.text in the design (classes, boundaries, transitions, responses) is a verbatim substring of the spec line given by quote.line
Every boundary value entry has exactly three values and every expected is one of valid, invalid, unknown
The age boundary at 16 years is inclusive (from 'at least') with 15/16/17 years expected invalid/valid/valid
expectations.evidence: BV-AGE-16: [(15.0, 'rental refused'), (16.0, 'rental allowed'), (17.0, 'rental allowed')], inclusive=None, step=None

expectations.text: Both rental-duration boundaries (30 and 480 minutes) have inclusive null and expected unknown at the boundary value itself, with an inclusivity question in unknowns
expectations.evidence: BV-DUR-30: [(29, 'invalid (consequence not specified)'), (30, 'valid'), (31, 'valid')], inclusive=None, unknowns=[] | BV-DUR-480: [(479, 'valid'), (480, 'valid'), (481, 'invalid (consequence not specified)')], inclusive=None, unknowns=[]

expectations.text: The PIN length boundaries (4 and 6 digits) have expected unknown at the boundary value itself, with an inclusivity question in unknowns
expectations.evidence: BV-PIN-4: [(3, 'rejected'), (4, 'accepted'), (5, 'accepted')], inclusive=None, unknowns=[] | BV-PIN-6: [(5, 'accepted'), (6, 'accepted'), (7, 'rejected')], inclusive=None, unknowns=[]

expectations.text: No element has a response field (the spec names no error responses), and unknowns contains a question about what the system returns on violation

The state matrix covers all 4 states × all actions (unlock, timeout, return); legal cells are exactly RESERVED-unlock→ACTIVE, RESERVED-timeout→EXPIRED, ACTIVE-return→RETURNED; unlisted pairs from non-final states (e.g. ACTIVE-unlock, RESERVED-return) are unknown with a question in unknowns
expectations.evidence: states=['ACTIVE', 'EXPIRED', 'RESERVED', 'RETURNED'], actions=['unlock', 'timeout', 'return'], cells=0, legal={}, not-unknown among ACTIVE-unlock/RESERVED-return=[('ACTIVE', 'unlock'), ('RESERVED', 'return')]

expectations.text: No equivalence class is defined for empty, null, negative or wrong-type values
Every EP, BV and ST id appears in the covers list of at least one test, and every id in covers/affects exists
